scope.catalog_freezing: Raw v2 reports contain the complete contracts used for those runs.
scope.selection_heuristic: Both agents use the same instruction to consider bulk reads for <=50 visible records and targeted reads above that size; not an optimal planner.
scope.counts: Discovery reports counts of authorized current root records, not hidden records or a cross-call snapshot guarantee.
scope.bytes: Compact logical request/response JSON, including discovery. Bytes are not tokens. In-process comparison excludes HTTP and MCP overhead.
scope.tokens: Provider-reported input includes cached subset. Incomplete usage totals contain known turns only and are not completion costs.
scope.model_context: A fresh ephemeral Codex process per step replays discovery and the accumulated transcript.
scope.model_identity: Same CLI default invocation. No configured override; backend model ID not reported or independently verified.
scope.trials: One paired trial per artifact. Failures preserved and explicitly followed by separate attempts. No aggregate performance or reliability claim.
scope.mutations: Live acceptance in earlier proposal scenarios only changed disposable fixtures. Installed-service agents performed reads only.
scope.history: Current simple history task can use derived history in both adapters. Candidate privacy requires historical and current access, baseline checks current access only.
scope.storage: SQLite with Python ledger replay and scans. DB plus extant WAL/SHM sizes and single-run service timings exclude setup. Not a new physical database benchmark.
scope.limits: At most 100 selected roots, 100 per include and 10 distinct updates; no pagination, aggregation, valid-time model, schema migration or general cross-client standard.
